name: Driftwood
stayType: Boutique guest house with self-catering lodge
accommodation: Six en-suite guest rooms (including two family rooms) plus the self-catering Driftwood Lodge sleeping up to 3
suitableFor: Couples, small families and dog owners wanting a B&B in the village
dogs: Welcome in Rooms One, Two, Three and Driftwood Lodge
beachAccess: Described as a short stroll from the beach
confirmedFeatures: Breakfast included, free Wi-Fi, smart TV, Bluetooth speakers, sea views, cot available, refurbished 2022
overview: Driftwood is a boutique guest house in Rhosneigr village, a short stroll from the beach. It has six en-suite rooms, two of which suit small families, and a self-catering lodge with its own kitchen. The house was refurbished in 2022 and serves breakfast to room guests.
surfTripFit: Being a short walk from the sand means you can check the surf on foot, and the dog-friendly rooms and lodge suit travellers bringing a dog.
